description: This Java test class, GoodreadsBookImportTest, contains parameterized unit tests for the GoodreadsBookImport class. It verifies the correct mapping of shelf names to predefined shelf enums and handles invalid input cases.

classes.name: GoodreadsBookImportTest
classes.description: JUnit 5 test class with parameterized tests for GoodreadsBookImport functionality.

methods.name: returnPredefinedShelfOnMatch
methods.description: Tests that shelf names 'to-read', 'currently-reading', and 'read' successfully map to predefined shelf enums.

methods.name: returnEmptyForInvalidShelfName
methods.description: Tests that invalid shelf names ('', ' ', 'shelf', null) result in an empty Optional response.

methods.name: generateInvalidShelfNames
methods.description: Provides a stream of invalid shelf name strings for parameterized testing.
